description: This file defines API routes for task management operations using FastAPI, including listing, creating, retrieving, updating, toggling completion, and deleting tasks. It primarily interacts with database models and schemas related to tasks.

classes.name: TaskCompleteToggle
classes.description: Schema for toggling task completion status.

classes.name: TaskCreate
classes.description: Schema for creating a new task.

classes.name: TaskOut
classes.description: Schema for task data returned in responses.

classes.name: TaskUpdate
classes.description: Schema for updating a task's data.

methods.name: Task _get_task_or_404(db: Session, task_id: int)
methods.description: Retrieves a task by ID or raises HTTP 404 if not found.

methods.name: List[Task] list_tasks( status_filter: Optional[TaskStatus] = Query( None, alias="status", description="Filter by status: todo|in_progress|done." ), search: Optional[str] = Query( None, description="Search substring against title and description (case-insensitive).", ), db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Lists tasks with optional filters for status and search term.

methods.name: Task create_task(payload: TaskCreate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Creates a new task and stores it in the database.

methods.name: Task get_task(task_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Retrieves a specific task by its ID.

methods.name: Task update_task(task_id: int, payload: TaskUpdate, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
methods.description: Performs a full update of a task's details.

methods.name: Task toggle_task_complete( task_id: int, payload: TaskCompleteToggle, db: Session = Depends(get_db), )
methods.description: Toggles or explicitly sets task completion status.

methods.name: None delete_task(task_id: int, db: Session = Depends(get_db))
